observations: Multiple stacks of used tires stored indoors/outdoors under a roof.
Photos show mixed tire sizes/conditions; tread depth varies and some tires look worn.
No clear brand/model markings are readable on the tire sidewalls in the provided photos.
No DOT date codes or manufacturing year are clearly readable.
Seller text overlay/watermark appears ("IKWE ANTHONY"), but it does not confirm tire brand/origin.

claims.evidence: Photos do not show readable brand/origin markings (e.g., sidewall brand, country of origin, or any Belgium-specific labeling).

risks.risk: Tire brand/model and exact size are not readable, so the buyer may receive different specs than expected (wrong fit/usage).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of each tire sidewall showing brand + model + size (e.g., 205/55R16) and any markings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as mixed used tires with unknown size/brand (worst-case for buyer: assume not matching the intended spec).

risks.risk: Condition uncertainty: tread depth, uneven wear, and possible damage (cuts/bulges) are not fully verifiable from these angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tread depth across the tire and both sidewalls (including any cracks/cuts/bulges), plus a photo of the inside rim area if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn used tires with unknown damage risk (worst-case: assume reduced life).

risks.risk: Age uncertainty: DOT date codes/manufacturing year are not readable, affecting safety and lifespan.
risks.proof: A sharp close-up of the DOT code on the sidewall for at least 2-3 tires (front and back of the same tire).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as older used tires (worst-case: assume near end-of-life).

risks.risk: Quantity/assortment mismatch: photos show many tires but not the exact count or which sizes are included in the offer.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the exact number of tires and grouping by size (count per size).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an assortment with unknown count and mix (worst-case: assume lower value mix).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the sidewall for each tire showing brand, model, and full size (e.g., 205/55R16).
Send DOT date code close-ups (at least 2-3 tires) with the numbers readable.
Send close-ups of tread depth and both sidewalls for any tires that look more worn or have visible marks.
Confirm the exact quantity and list the sizes included (count per size).
response.reason: From the photos, the tires are clearly used and mixed, but the key details needed to price correctly (readable size/brand/model and DOT age) are not visible. Without that, a worst-case price cannot be set reliably.
